import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*x+params[3]*v+params[4]*v**2
            +params[5]*np.sin(x)+params[6]*np.sin(v)
            +(params[7]*x+params[8]*v)*C+(params[9]*x)*S)
